instruction: A large hanging temple bell: a tall rounded bronze bell body flaring to a thick lip at the bottom, a decorative suspension loop (dragon-crown) at the top, raised banding and bosses on the surface, and a greenish patina. Reduced-scale study.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a temple bell. A large hanging temple bell: a tall rounded bronze bell body flaring to a thick lip at the bottom, a decorative suspension loop (dragon-crown) at the top, raised banding and bosses on the surface, and a greenish patina. Reduced-scale study. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
